column3: NASB capitalizes “Spirit,” and “moving over” renders “hovering over”; “formless and void” renders “tohu and bohu.”
“an expanse” renders “raqia,” the firmament (also in verses 7–8, 14–17, 20).
“in the open expanse of the heavens” renders “on the face of the expanse of the heavens.”
NASB capitalizes “Us” and “Our”; “man” renders “adam,” humankind, and “sky” renders “heavens” (also in verse 28).
“man” renders “the adam,” humankind; the Hebrew “him” is singular as in NASB.
“I have given” is supplied from verse 29 to complete the sentence.
